description: This file defines the OrderController class in an ASP.NET Core MVC project, handling user order listing and order detail views through HTTP GET actions, utilizing MediatR for mediating requests.

classes.name: OrderController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core MVC controller managing order-related actions such as listing user orders and displaying order details.

methods.name: MyOrders
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display the current user's orders.

methods.name: Detail
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display details of a specific order identified by orderId.
